notes: The permanent enchants each spec wears in the BiS ranker's raid pass at level 60 (sim/cmd/leveling-bis/enchants.go): what a fresh level 60 can buy or have made in Phase 1, with no raid, Zul'Gurub, Dire Maul, Ahn'Qiraj or Naxxramas recipe. Ids are the active build's enchants.json effect ids. A profile is a role's slot plan; a spec names one and may override slots. Slot keys: the armor slots by planner name, ranged, main_hand and off_hand for a one-handed weapon, two_hand for a two-hander in the main hand, shield for a shield in the off hand. A held-in-off-hand item and rings and trinkets take none. Evidence per enchant: design/reviews/2026-11-04-raid-enchants.md.
